label: canvas-state-mobile
method: read-only Playwright probe of the deployed page, mobile emulation, 8 s settle, no Start press
conclusions: The shipped meter renders at the balanced tier's 1.6 pixel-ratio cap, not DPR 3.
The canvas is 0.27 MP, so the 1,976-2,118 ms GLES2::ReadPixels cost recorded in Phase 0 is not proportional to canvas area.
The canvas host carries the 600 ms opacity transition that the reveal hand-off animates.
A single meter instance exists on the page; an earlier 2.5 s probe read opacity 0 while the transition was still starting.
